project_name: Fayr Admin Panel - Omnichannel SaaS Ops & Customer Experience Desk
theme: Light theme, modern SaaS Freshdesk DEW-inspired professional aesthetic

layout_structure.sidebar: Fixed left navigation (64px collapsed / 240px expanded) with team switchers, presence badge, unread counters, and dark navy or clean slate border.
layout_structure.header: Top action bar with team scope selector, global search (CMD+K), quick agent status toggle (Online/Away/Offline), AI Assist trigger, and quick stats pill.
layout_structure.main_content: Multi-pane responsive grid. For Inboxes: 3-column split layout (Column 1: Ticket/Chat List with search & filters, Column 2: Threaded Conversation & Reply Box, Column 3: Customer Context, AI Reply Assist & Ticket Properties).
layout_structure.density: High density data layout with crisp 1px borders, subtle hover effects, tight padding (p-3 to p-5 for lists, p-6 for workspace containers).

shared_inbox.description: Email-to-ticket list with priority tags (Urgent, High, Medium, Low), SLA countdown timers, Marketplace badge (Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra), assignees, and quick status filters (Open, Pending, Escalated, Resolved).

ticket_detail_composer.description: Chronological email/chat thread. Multi-channel editor with tabs for 'Reply to Customer' vs 'Internal Note' (yellow background tint). Includes rich text controls, template canned responses, attachment upload, and send button.

agent_assignment_and_transfer.description: Agent dropdown with live availability indicators. 'Reassign / Transfer Ticket' modal with optional note for target agent or team escalation.

live_chat_inbox.description: Real-time feel chat sidebar with typing indicator, active session timers, customer sentiment badge (Positive, Neutral, Frustrated), and quick transfer control.

agent_presence_routing.description: Status toggle in header (Available - Online, Away - Lunch/Break, Busy - On Call, Offline) with real-time routing status badge.

ai_assist_panel.description: Side drawer/panel providing 1-click AI Reply Suggestions (Polite Refund Approval, Escalation Notice, Review Guidelines Check), AI Chat Summary bullet points, and Customer Sentiment Tagging.

operations_ocr_queue.description: Claims review table displaying user-submitted marketplace invoice/screenshot OCR output against marketplace purchase verification. Approve/Reject buttons with reason selector.

finance_approval_ledger.description: Refund/Withdrawal request queue with UPI ID verification, user total claim count, balance audit, ledger table, and batch disbursement actions.

admin_management_overview.description: Staff directory grid, active agent shift timer, auto-assignment queue rules, SLA breach warning triggers, and team productivity charts.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a rich, interactive, realistic single-page application dashboard for Fayr Admin Panel in JavaScript (.jsx/.js files).
Implement the 5 team sections accessible via the left sidebar: Customer Support, Operations, Frontend Operations, Finance, and Admin/Management.
Include a unified top status bar with real-time agent presence toggle (Online, Away, Busy, Offline), global metric pills, and CMD+K search trigger.

For Customer Support: provide both Shared Team Inbox (threaded email tickets with reply/internal note composer, AI suggestions, ticket re-assignment) AND Live Chat Console (real-time chat list, typing indicator, transfer flow).
For Operations: provide OCR Evidence & Review Proof Verification queue with image proof preview modal, Amazon/Flipkart/Meesho/Myntra product link checker, and approve/reject claims.
For Finance: provide Wallet Refund & Cash Withdrawal approvals with user transaction ledger view, UPI status, and batch approval trigger.
For Admin/Management: provide Team & Staff roster, live workload meters, SLA response configuration, and role permission modifiers.
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='ticket-list-item').
Use Framer Motion for smooth tab switches, modal slide-ins, and drawer expansions.
Use Sonner for toasts when tickets are assigned, status updated, or claims approved/rejected.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or forbidden teal #1B93A4. Maintain crisp Slate/Blue/Emerald palette with subtle shadows and border-slate-200.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for floating action panels and modals.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use Lucide icons (lucide-react) exclusively.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, slide-ins.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
